title: What's New: Exporting and Importing Agent in Business Central

chapters.title: Why export agents and overview of export options
Exporting agents via the UI - live demonstration
Import process overview and security features
Importing agents - file selection and preview
Reviewing import details and validation warnings

features.name: Export agent definition
features.description: Users can export agent definitions as XML files either from the agent card via an export agent definition action or from the agent list to back up agents or share them across environments.

features.name: Agent XML format
features.description: The exported XML file contains all information related to the agent including name, display name, permissions, and instructions.

features.name: Import agent definition
features.description: Users can import agent definitions from XML files through an import agent definition wizard that allows preview of changes, review of warnings, selection of which agents to import, and activation when ready.
caveats: Validation warnings may indicate missing dependencies like profiles that need manual fixing after import

features.name: Agent import preview
features.description: Before importing, users can preview the agent definitions that will be imported to review what changes will occur to existing agents.

features.name: Agent validation warnings
features.description: During import, users receive validation status with warnings and errors indicating potential issues with agent definitions, such as missing profiles or other configuration problems.
caveats: Users must manually fix issues after import if warnings are not resolved

features.name: Agent replace or create option
features.description: During import, users can choose whether to replace existing agents or create new instances instead of replacing.

features.name: Agent activation after import
features.description: After importing agents, users can activate them directly from the import results view or navigate to the agent card to review permissions and other settings before activation.

features.name: Agent productization via API
features.description: Agents can be productized through AL code via the API by using exported definitions with Copilot as a reference to fill in instructions and other configuration.
